limits: Command fixtures execute the actual unchanged/candidate wrapper and real Linux subprocesses; their planning/CI/readiness functions and Astro/Vitest programs are controlled replacements, not a full browser acceptance run.
Root will run an actual focused Vitest command through the final integrated runner.
Windows keeps PID-scoped hidden taskkill /T /F; no native Windows execution is claimed, and a parent that exits before taskkill remains a limitation of that existing native mechanism.
Non-Linux POSIX uses owned process groups, not the Linux /proc inherited-marker recovery.

The initial fixture/setup iterations and interrupted counterfactual are retained in iterations.txt and runtime-process-owner-baseline-interrupted.log; they are not counted as completed product evidence.
